blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A woman was arrested after allegedly being caught with more than P1 million worth of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) in a buy-bust operation in Dasmariñas City, Cavite. The Police Regional Office 4A said in a report on Friday that anti-illegal drug operatives apprehended the suspect at around 7:40 p.m. on Thursday night (October 22). She was captured after she allegedly sold P1,000 worth of shabu to an undercover police officer in Barangay Salitran 2.
